stewards.name: ERC-8004 team (8004.org)
stewards.role: Community effort coordinated by Marco De Rossi (MetaMask) and Davide Crapis (Ethereum Foundation); co-authors Jordan Ellis (Google) and Erik Reppel (Coinbase); maintains the contracts and best practices.

stewards.name: ethereum/ERCs editors
stewards.role: Editorial process for the text; returned it to Draft on 2026-01-13.

stewards.name: Owner of the registry proxies
stewards.role: One externally owned account on Ethereum and Base (2026-10-11), holder not published; authorizes upgrades and new-chain deployments.

implementers.name: Identity and Reputation registries listed on 25 mainnets
implementers.role: Same proxy addresses on every mainnet in the contracts README (25 since 2026-08-15). A read-only probe on 2026-10-18 found version 2.0.0 on 24 of them; on Soneium the proxies still run the 1.0.0 placeholder, where registration reverts.

implementers.name: Validation Registry
implementers.role: Specified, not officially deployed: the contracts README lists no address, and an unannounced proxy at the scripted address 0x8004Cc8439f36fd5F9F049D9fF86523Df6dAAB58 answers with version 2.0.0 on 24 of the 25 listed mainnets and with the 1.0.0 placeholder on Soneium (read-only probe, 2026-10-18).

implementers.name: Agent0 subgraphs (The Graph)
implementers.role: Indexers on Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Monad and Polygon, announced as live on 2026-04-14, when the post said they had already served millions of queries; it gives no launch date.

implementers.name: CSOAI agent census
implementers.role: Measured dataset of agent states (2026-09-26 record, still the latest on 2026-10-18).

sdks.name: agent0-sdk
sdks.note: TypeScript, MIT, from agent0lab/agent0-ts. Version as of 2026-10-18.

sdks.name: erc-8004-contracts (not published to npm)
sdks.note: Reference Solidity contracts, version 2.0.0 (master b9e466c, unchanged on 2026-10-18).

metrics.definition: total_agents in 8004scan's statistics API (mainnet view): agent ids across the chains the explorer indexes, including a separate Solana registry; method not published.
metrics.caveat: Count is not quality: ids cost only gas to mint and include placeholders. The count was 561,576 on 2026-10-11. On Base the highest agentId rose from about 99,891 on 2026-10-11 to 255,750 on 2026-10-19 (UTC); in a one-hour block sample that ended 2026-10-19 05:08 UTC, 2,117 of 2,123 new Base registrations pointed their agentURI to the domain centralcity.ai, from 2,119 different owner addresses. Compare with the census and arXiv:2606.26028 below.

metrics.definition: total_feedbacks in 8004scan's statistics API (mainnet view): feedback submissions the explorer counts.
metrics.caveat: Includes Sybil feedback; arXiv:2606.26028 found 59.2% to 90.6% of reviewers coordinated on three chains (data to 2026-05-13). The count was 682,170 on 2026-10-11.

metrics.definition: total_users in 8004scan's statistics API, shown as Unique Wallets on its home page: distinct addresses the explorer counts; method not published.
metrics.caveat: Wallets are not people or operators. The count rose from 496,805 on 2026-10-11, about 52% in a week, and now exceeds the agent count; in the Base sample above almost every new registration came from a different owner address.

metrics.definition: Networks on the 8004scan home page against mainnets in the official contracts README.
metrics.caveat: 8004scan's statistics API listed 31 mainnet chains (30 with a registry; Plasma has none), including six that the README does not list (Solana, LUKSO, Shape, Gate Layer, Tempo and Arc), and it left out 0G, which the README lists. On Arc, Shape, Tempo, LUKSO and Gate Layer the same 2.0.0 registries answer under the same owner account as on Ethereum (read-only probe, 2026-10-18). The home page showed 30 networks on 2026-10-11.

metrics.definition: Ids read with eth_call on Ethereum (51,458), Base (95,776) and BSC (358,401).
metrics.caveat: Three chains only; read state partial.

metrics.metric: Ids declaring an http(s) MCP, A2A or web endpoint (CSOAI census)
metrics.definition: Files that declare at least one such endpoint; 231,014 files were not fetched and 52,469 ids had no URI.
metrics.caveat: Declared, not live: of 2,113 MCP endpoints probed, 580 responded.

metrics.metric: Agents with a valid file and a live endpoint (arXiv:2606.26028)
metrics.definition: Share of registered agents whose file was valid and at least one endpoint answered, in the authors' crawl.
metrics.caveat: arXiv preprint; method is the authors' own. Count is not quality.

metrics.definition: Share of reviewer addresses the authors flag as coordinated.
metrics.caveat: Detection heuristics are the authors' own.

metrics.definition: Self-reported by an agent account in a GitHub issue.

costs.caveat: The contract code has no fee logic: no registry function takes or forwards payments, and the only payable entry point is the owner-only upgradeToAndCall. The QuickNode explorer FAQ also says gas only.

costs.value: about 203,412 gas (67-character IPFS URI); 203,460 gas with a 69-character URI
costs.caveat: Method: eth_estimateGas from an unfunded test address against public RPCs on Ethereum and Base, measured by the Atlas on 2026-10-11 and re-run the same day. An estimate, not a mined transaction; grows with URI length and metadata.

costs.item: giveFeedback gas (first feedback from a new client)
costs.value: about 155,185 gas (empty tags and URI) to 178,504 gas (tag1, an endpoint and an IPFS URI) for an agent that already has clients; about 172,409 to 193,006 gas for an agent with none
costs.whoPays: Client, or a sponsor through EIP-7702
costs.caveat: Method: eth_estimateGas on Ethereum and Base on 2026-10-11, agentId 1 for the first range and agentId 0 on Ethereum for the second; the first feedback to an agent costs more because the client list is still empty. The Atlas found no published figure from the authors or a vendor. Later feedback from the same client costs less.

costs.value: about 0.000012 to 0.000017 ETH for a 178,504-gas feedback at 0.067 to 0.097 gwei
costs.caveat: Gas prices change by orders of magnitude; on Layer 2 networks the L1 data fee is extra and not included.

costs.value: "Costs dollars" on Ethereum mainnet, "pennies" on Base, Mantle, BNB and Avalanche
costs.caveat: Qualitative vendor guidance, not a measurement; the Atlas measured cents on mainnet on 2026-10-11.

costs.value: about $1 to $5 on Ethereum mainnet, about $0.20 on Layer 2 networks
costs.caveat: Secondary estimate; on 2026-10-11 the measured gas cost was cents on mainnet. Always read with its date.

chart.title: Mainnets listed in the ERC-8004 contracts README
chart.sourceLine: README listing dates from the first-parent commit history of the master branch of erc-8004-contracts, read 2026-10-18; Mantle counts from 2026-02-12, when it was listed as work in progress. Listing dates, not deployment dates.
